mentions.name: Vocast
mentions.description: A self-hosted TTS CLI application that converts articles into spoken audio, which can be streamed from a PC to a mobile device when out and about. Planned features include queuing RSS feed items for audio conversion and triggering conversion from a phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on my self-host TTS cli application for turning articles into spoken audio which I can stream from my PC to mobile device when I'm out and about.

It's called Vocast: https://github.com/cnrmurphy/vocast
